simple.meaning: properly, to push forth ; (but used only figuratively) to lash , i.e. (the sea with oars) to row ; by implication, to travel

definitions.short: properly, to push forth ; (but used only figuratively) to lash , i.e. (the sea with oars) to row ; by implication, to travel
definitions.usage: go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.
definitions.full: H7751. shuwt I. שׁוּט verb go or rove about (Late Hebrew, Aramaic שׁוּט rove, row ( Jonah 1:13 ), swim ( Isa 25:11 ), stroke , besmear ; see also שׁוֺט ); — Qal go or rove about: Perfect 3plural, absolute הָעָם שָׁטוּ Num 11:8 (J; gathering manna), so, with ב location, Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיָּשֻׁטוּ 2Sam 24:8 , Imperative masculine singular שׁוּטנָֿא 24:2 , Infinitive construct שׁוּט Job 1:7 , שֻׁט 2:2 (both || הִתְהַלֵךְ ), perhaps also Gen 24:63 ( לָשׁוּט for לָשׁוּחַ , so ᵑ6 Thes 1322 compare Di Gunk Dr); Jer 8:6 Du reads שָׁט for שָׁב . — Participle שָׁטִים see שׁוּט denominative below Po`l. go eagerly, quickly, to and fro: Imperfect 3masculine singular לְבַקֵּשׁ יְשׁוֺטְטוּ Amos 8:12 (|| וְנָעוּ ); absolute יְשֹׁטְטוּ Dan 12:4 ; with ב location, Imperative masculine plural שׁוֺטְטוּ Jer 5:1 , Participle plural מְשׁוֺטְטִים Zech 4:10 , מְשֹׁטְטוֺת 2Chr 16:9 (both of י ׳עֵינֵי ). Hithpo`lel Imperative feminine plural, ב location, הִתְשׁוֺטַטְנָת Jer 49:3 run to and fro.
